components.label: Box body
components.hint: Rear wall: four Ø16.2 mm M16 gland holes and one 24 × 5 mm camera ribbon slot. Position the standard Bike Plate tray 17 mm toward the front to leave 37 mm behind it for cables.

components.label: Gasketed lid
components.hint: Hide the lid to inspect the cavity. Fit 3 mm gasket cord in the body groove.
